semiconductor_relevance: High — GBS metrology GmbH provides specialized measurement systems for semiconductor applications, crucial for quality assurance and production processes.
summary: GBS metrology GmbH develops and manufactures white light interferometers and optical 3D measurement systems for the semiconductor industry. Their products are used for non-contact measurement of surface roughness and topography, suitable for both laboratory and automated production environments.
capabilities: White light interferometers for semiconductor applications
Optical 3D measurement systems for surface analysis
Inline and atline sensor integration for production automation
Customized measurement systems with integrated software
